text: R01 :: A purchase above EUR 5,000 is obligated to receive Finance approval before the purchase order is issued.
R02 :: For a purchase of exactly EUR 5,000, Finance approval is not required.
R03 :: For a purchase below EUR 5,000, the department manager is permitted to approve the purchase but is not obliged to approve it.
R04 :: A requester is prohibited from ever approving their own purchase request.
R05 :: An emergency purchase is exempt from obtaining competitive quotations.
R06 :: The emergency quotation exemption does not remove the Finance approval requirement for a purchase above EUR 5,000.
R07 :: Exclusively the Head of Finance can provide the Finance approval, and the buyer is prohibited from providing it.
R08 :: If a requester cancels a request before approval, that requester is obligated to record the cancellation reason.
R09 :: Approval records are obligated to be retained for at least 30 calendar days and cannot be deleted earlier than 30 calendar days.
R10 :: The purchase threshold applies separately to each request and does not apply to the monthly total for a supplier.
R11 :: Different suppliers may have the same supplier name, and the supplier name is not a unique identifier.
R12 :: The retention period begins on the approval date and does not begin on the purchase-order date.
